settings.question: How can I place an order on Grey Exim?
settings.answer: Add the required products and variants to your shopping bag, review the quantity and price, and proceed to checkout. Enter accurate contact, shipping and payment information, then submit the order.

settings.question: When is my order confirmed?
settings.answer: Your order is confirmed after Grey Exim accepts it and sends an order-confirmation communication. An acknowledgement of your request does not by itself guarantee acceptance. We may contact you if verification or additional information is required.

settings.question: Can I modify or cancel an order?
settings.answer: Submit your request as soon as possible through Contact Us. A modification or cancellation is not guaranteed after processing, packing or dispatch has begun. Any approved cancellation and refund will follow our Payment Policy and Return & Refund Policy.

settings.question: Do I need an account to place or return an order?
settings.answer: You may use the checkout options made available on the website. Registered customers can review account-related order information and saved details. Guest customers can submit a return request using the email address and order number associated with their purchase.

settings.question: What information does Grey Exim keep in my account?
settings.answer: Depending on the features you use, we may process your name, contact details, login credentials, saved addresses, preferences, order history and account activity. Authentication and account infrastructure may be provided through Shopify. See our Privacy Policy.

settings.question: When must I request a return or exchange?
settings.answer: For an eligible change-of-mind, size, colour or variant-related request, contact Grey Exim within 48 hours of delivery. Submitting a request does not automatically guarantee approval; the request and returned product may be inspected for eligibility.

settings.question: What condition must a returned product be in?
settings.answer: The product must meet the eligibility conditions in our Return & Refund Policy. Keep it unused, unworn, unwashed, undamaged and complete with its original tags, packaging and included accessories. Products that fail inspection may be rejected.

settings.question: Is return pickup free?
settings.answer: Grey Exim provides free return pickup for an approved eligible return where pickup service is available. Do not self-ship a product unless Grey Exim has expressly authorised it. Pickup availability and further instructions are provided after approval.

settings.question: When will I receive my refund?
settings.answer: A refund is initiated only after the returned product is received, inspected and approved. It is normally issued to the original payment method where supported. The time for the amount to appear can vary by bank, card network or payment provider.

settings.question: Where can I read all return and refund conditions?
settings.answer: Please review the complete Return & Refund Policy before submitting a request. It explains eligibility, excluded products, pickup, inspection, exchanges, cancellations and refunds.

settings.question: How long does delivery normally take?
settings.answer: Products are processed on the date the order is placed and are typically delivered within 5 to 7 working days, depending on the shipping address and courier availability. Weather, strikes, transport disruption and other circumstances beyond our control may cause delays.

settings.question: How are shipping charges and methods decided?
settings.answer: Available shipping methods and charges, if any, are determined using your delivery location, order contents, total and courier availability, and are displayed at checkout. Any free-shipping promotion will be clearly stated on the website.

settings.question: How can I track my shipment?
settings.answer: After dispatch, tracking information is sent using the contact details provided with the order. You can also use Track your order. For assistance, contact care@greyexim.com.

settings.question: Which payment methods can I use?
settings.answer: Online payments are processed through the Paytm Payment Gateway. Cash on Delivery (COD) may also be offered for eligible orders and locations. The exact methods available for your order are always shown at checkout.

settings.question: What should I do if my payment fails or is duplicated?
settings.answer: First check the transaction status with your bank or payment provider and avoid repeatedly submitting payment while a transaction is pending. If an amount was debited, a payment failed or a duplicate charge appears, contact care@greyexim.com with your order and transaction details.

settings.question: Are my payment details stored by Grey Exim?
settings.answer: Payments are handled through the payment services available at checkout. Grey Exim may receive transaction status, reference information and limited or masked payment information, but payment providers process payment credentials under their own security and privacy practices.

settings.question: How does Grey Exim use my personal information?
settings.answer: We use relevant personal data to operate the store, process orders and payments, arrange shipping, manage returns and refunds, provide account and customer support, prevent fraud, meet legal obligations and send marketing only where permitted. See our Privacy Policy.

settings.question: How can I manage cookies and privacy choices?
settings.answer: Use the website's Cookie Settings or privacy-preferences control to review optional cookie choices. Essential technologies may remain active because they support the cart, checkout, login, security and other requested functions. You can also review our Cookie Policy.
